title: Location_Index
description: Lightweight lookup and redirection index resolving verbatim, shorthand, or historical location strings to canonical location IDs.

last_modified.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last index update.

total_mappings.description: Total count of redirect keys registered in the index.

redirects.description: Dictionary keyed by normalized lowercase alias, abbreviation, or historical token mapping directly to canonical location references.

standardized.description: Canonical standardized jurisdiction or venue string matching the location entity.
